summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate) in the repository. Changes: added an Update(prologue, algebra) container in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py beside Query; translateUpdate in algebra.py now returns an Update on every path, building the prologue from the single declaration group before the empty-request early exit; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py and exported from the sparql package __init__.py; new test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers the spec's test list. Nothing was run (per instructions), so tests and black formatting are unverified. Known points to review: group 0's prologue is applied twice on the non-empty path (idempotent, but redundant); test_dawg.py's debug pprintAlgebra call receives the container and was left unchanged. Nothing was committed.
